PRINTABLE COLOR CARDS

Color Flashcards: print all twelve color pairs

Twelve colors, each printed as a paint splash card beside its matching picture card, from red to rainbow.

Made for age 3 and up — one color per page, splash and picture side by side. The cards print in card order — cut them out or use them as they are. When you are ready, choose Print Cards.

Back to class ↗

Printing happens in your browser — nothing is uploaded and nothing is installed. No PDF is involved.
